name: Haishin Seido ~Kanojo ga Toukou Sareru Wake~
original_name: 配信性奴 ～彼女が投稿される理由～
source:
An ordinary protagonist whose hobby is streaming videos. One day, his live-in girlfriend Momoko Yanagi was briefly shown in her underwear during a broadcast.

However, the protagonist is surprised when he sees the number of views of the video later. Since then, he's gradually become interested in distributing erotic videos in order to increase the number of views and channel subscriptions.

At first, Momoko acts like a voyeur, but the sexual activity gradually escalates...

Also joining the group are Megumi Hayakawa, a frustrated middle-aged woman who sees the video and wishes she could participate, and Rina Yoshioka, a student from a prestigious school who wants to earn money by appearing in the video. The video footage becomes more extreme and shameful.

What kind of outcome will the main characters end up with after this immoral act towards the girls and the accelerating number of posts?

[Translated from [url=http://ulb-potage.co.jp/riddlesoft/html/img/haisin.jpg]Official website[/url]]
translation:
主人公是个爱直播视频的普通人。某天，他同居的女友柳桃子在直播中短暂露出了内裤。

然而，主人公后来看到视频播放量时大吃一惊。从此，他逐渐对发布色情视频产生兴趣，希望增加播放量与频道订阅数。

起初，桃子像个偷窥者一样行动，但性行为逐渐升级……

此外，看到视频后希望参与其中的受挫中年女性早川惠，以及想通过出演视频赚钱的名门学校学生吉冈莉奈，也加入了这个团体。视频内容变得越来越极端、越来越羞耻。

对女孩们做出这种不道德行为、发布数量不断增加后，主角们最终会迎来怎样的结局？

（译自[url=http://ulb-potage.co.jp/riddlesoft/html/img/haisin.jpg]官方网站[/url]）
